entries.journey.lighthouse.story.1: Anna's familiar bag rests by the path. Its patch is the same one you saw at the forest camp.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.2: Fresh footprints mark the old boards. Someone kept bringing belongings here even after the pier stopped welcoming boats.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.3: Inside the dry tent, Anna unfolds plans of the tower. Her grandfather once tended its light, but his last notes end abruptly.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.4: An empty shelf is visible through the tower window. It once held a lantern; a hook for a familiar scarf still hangs beside it.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.5: The letter does not say where the keeper went. It asks only that a light be left for those returning late.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.6: Bohdan recognizes the scarf: a visitor at the old station wore it in winter. How it reached this place remains unknown.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.7: The guests bring the last boards and clean the glass. They are no longer waiting to be rescued; they are making a place to meet.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.8: The tower shines over your camp again. Two cups wait on the bench. One signature in the letter is still unreadable: this place has its ending, but its people's story continues.

entries.journey.intro: Each story follows its own trail, with new glades and familiar guests.
entries.journey.empty: New stories are still being prepared. For now, continue along the main trail.
entries.journey.progressRequirement: This route opens after {0} places on the main story path.
entries.journey.memories.title: Roadside Memories
entries.journey.memories.description: Three glades about places you already made safe. A free story — unlocked by playing.
entries.journey.memories.story.1: Anna recognized the path — this is where you pitched your first tent. She returned because the place stayed safe.
entries.journey.memories.story.2: Distant fires glow at the forest edge. Bohdan counts them aloud — each fire is a place you once opened.
entries.journey.memories.story.3: The old camp post still stands. Fresh marks on it — strangers have flagged this spot as a reliable shelter.
entries.journey.main.story.31: The old crossing creaks underfoot — the road between your camps is walkable again.
entries.journey.main.story.32: Someone left a lantern on the bridge rail. Anna says it lit the way for the last travellers, years ago.
entries.journey.main.story.33: Bohdan recognizes the spot where he once waited for his boat. Now it sleeps travellers under a roof of branches.
entries.journey.main.story.34: Beyond the bridge lies a glade you settled earlier. People have started asking the way to it again.
entries.journey.main.story.35: The old station platform is swept after years of silence. The timetable matters to no one yet — but warmth has returned.
entries.journey.main.story.36: The former farm smells of hay. Someone put it back in order — and passers-by have a place to rest again.
entries.journey.main.story.37: Names of guests are carved into the station wall. Among them are people who slept in your very first camps.
entries.journey.main.story.38: The evening train no longer stops here, but the bench under the canopy is never empty now.
entries.journey.main.story.39: The shore of an abandoned settlement smells of salt and smoke. Boats have not landed for years — your fires are visible from the water.
entries.journey.main.story.40: Waves wash the old pier. Your glade is the one place people still return to here.
entries.journey.main.story.41: The half-ruined house by the shore is smoking again — a neighbour has appeared nearby.
entries.journey.main.story.42: The road from your first glade to this shore is open now. The network of places is alive — people are coming back.
entries.district.glades.title: First Glades
entries.district.glades.intro: Your first glades. Place tents so every guest keeps a path to their door — that is the foundation of everything.
entries.district.forest.title: The Forest Path
entries.district.forest.intro: Deeper forest glades. Same rules, new places — watch the signs near fires and shade.
entries.district.embers.title: Someone's Fires
entries.district.embers.intro: Camps with fires and shade lie ahead. You already know how to make places safe — now make them feel like home.
entries.district.bridges.title: Old Bridges
entries.district.bridges.intro: Thirty glades behind you. Now those places begin to connect — the old bridges carry the road between camps again.
entries.district.stations.title: Stations and Farms
entries.district.stations.intro: Next come stations and farms where people once lived. Your camps make these places work again.
entries.district.shores.title: Shores and Settlements
entries.district.shores.intro: The last stretch — abandoned settlements on the shores. Settle them, and the network of places is complete.
entries.map.bonus.frost.title: The Frost Glade
entries.map.bonus.frost.description: First snow on the pines and a quiet place waiting for a winter evening. Only opens in winter.

entries.guide.sign.friends: Friends — a short path between their tent doors.
entries.district.farms.title: Working fields
entries.district.farms.intro: Fields and farms feeding the road again. People return where there is a place to sleep.
entries.district.mills.title: Mills on the river
entries.district.mills.intro: Old mills await new hands. The banks are narrow — mind your steps near the water.
entries.district.villages.title: Villages rising again
entries.district.villages.intro: Half the village stands, half is ruin. Your camps decide which yards will live again.
entries.district.passes.title: Mountain passes
entries.district.passes.intro: The passes remember everyone who crossed. In cold and mist a fire counts double.
entries.district.resort.title: The abandoned resort
entries.district.resort.intro: The resort is frozen in its last summer. Rain patterns on the gazebos are stories nobody finished.
entries.district.coast.title: The salt shore
entries.district.coast.intro: The shore smells of salt and tar. The lighthouse is visible from here — someone finally lit it.
entries.district.highlands.title: The highlands
entries.district.highlands.intro: Up high the trails are narrow and dangerous. Places you arrange here will save more than one traveler.
entries.district.frontier.title: The far frontier
entries.district.frontier.intro: The last mapped road. Beyond it only tracks of those who walked before you — and those who will follow.
entries.district.haven.title: The haven
entries.district.haven.intro: The end of the main road — and the start of everything else. The haven welcomes everyone who walked it.
entries.journey.mountain.title: The mountain route
entries.journey.mountain.description: Twenty-four camps upward through the passes. The scarf found near the lighthouse once walked this road.
entries.journey.resort.title: The abandoned resort
entries.journey.resort.description: Thirty glades in a resort stuck in its last summer. Repair, read strangers' notes, and decide what stays behind.
entries.journey.coast.title: The coastline
entries.journey.coast.description: Twenty shoreline camps along fishing paths. The lighthouse shines — but who keeps it at night?
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.10: The tower stairs know your steps. Halfway up, a child's drawing: the lighthouse and three tents, made many years ago.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.15: The keeper's log holds a page about a storm when the light saved an entire boat. It is signed by a name you heard at the station.
entries.journey.lighthouse.story.20: The lamp is lit for the first time in twelve years. On the beach below, someone waves back — the lighthouse arc is complete, the shore remains.
entries.journey.garden.story.5: The glass survived winter. Under a shard: dry seed packets, left on purpose for whoever returned.
entries.journey.garden.story.10: First sprouts break through the moss. Anna writes dates in the old garden journal — its pages are filling again.
entries.journey.garden.story.15: A stranger's key fits the shed. Inside: tools and a note — tend it until we return. The note is five years old.
entries.journey.garden.story.20: The greenhouse is green again. Neighbouring farms bring their first orders — the garden is officially alive.
entries.journey.garden.story.25: The last frame is set. Bohdan writes the final journal line: the garden no longer needs permission to grow.
entries.journey.station.story.5: The wall timetable is a decade old. Beneath it, fresh chalk: we meet here at 18:00.
entries.journey.station.story.10: A pouch of tickets with blank dates turns up. People have started writing the names they are waiting for.
entries.journey.station.story.15: The first real arrival: not a train — an old handcar carrying a roofer. He says the station has earned it.
entries.journey.mountain.story.5: The pass is marked by a cairn — everyone who crossed left a stone. You add yours.
entries.journey.mountain.story.10: In the shelter: pages of a ranger's journal. He watched the lighthouse from up here — its light died the same night his brother vanished.
entries.journey.mountain.story.15: A slide rerouted the trail, but your camps marked the detour. Travelers already use it without knowing who made it.
entries.journey.mountain.story.20: The summit. In a stone niche, the ranger's final page: he descended to the lighthouse. Two story threads finally meet.
entries.journey.resort.story.5: A 1998 vacation ticket holds a poolside photo. Today a young garden grows there — and that is better.
entries.journey.resort.story.10: The kitchen smells of sage, not soup — but the pantry kept a menu: evening marshmallows for everyone. Some traditions deserve returning.
entries.journey.resort.story.15: Gazebo No.7 hides a gramophone. The record says: come back next summer. Nine years have passed.
entries.journey.resort.story.20: First rooms open. Guests form a key queue — a story asleep for ten years finally wakes.
entries.journey.resort.story.25: The fountain runs again. Guests entered last evening in the guest book — the first new entry in the resort's century.
entries.journey.resort.story.30: The resort is abandoned no more. The administrator's closing line from 1998 can finally be read aloud.
entries.journey.coast.story.5: The fishing ropes are still sound — someone checked them recently. Someone who may still be waiting for a boat.
entries.journey.coast.story.10: On the cliff, a shoal map marked: here sleeps the old bay. Below lies a dry pier missing from every chart.
entries.journey.coast.story.15: The anchored boat is not abandoned: fresh oil on the cabin lamp, two cups. The owner is close.
entries.journey.coast.story.20: The last pier. On the post, a hook where a scarf once hung. You know who used to wear it.
entries.map.bonus.lantern.title: Lantern nook
entries.map.bonus.lantern.description: An evening lantern over a quiet path — a place that shines for late walkers.
entries.map.bonus.creek.title: Creekside
entries.map.bonus.creek.description: Cold water, stones and the evening song of a creek between two camps.
entries.map.bonus.meadow.title: Open meadow
entries.map.bonus.meadow.description: An open field where the wind carries seeds all the way to the next camp.
entries.map.bonus.pinewood.title: Pine shelter
entries.map.bonus.pinewood.description: Tall pines and resin in the air — a natural roof for a quiet night.
entries.map.bonus.birch.title: Birch copse
entries.map.bonus.birch.description: Young birches and spring light — a place that smells of new leaves.
entries.map.bonus.quarry.title: Old quarry
entries.map.bonus.quarry.description: A stone amphitheatre where echoes still remember working voices.
entries.map.bonus.orchard.title: Orchard rows
entries.map.bonus.orchard.description: Tree rows in colour — the seasonal pie here is always shared.
entries.map.bonus.highmoor.title: High moor
entries.map.bonus.highmoor.description: A moss wilderness above the forest where silence is thick as fog.
entries.map.bonus.homestead.title: Old homestead
entries.map.bonus.homestead.description: A roofless house with a garden — this place's story is not finished.
entries.map.bonus.spring.title: Spring glade
entries.map.bonus.spring.description: First flowers and the first warm night — only opens in spring.
entries.map.bonus.summer.title: Summer glade
entries.map.bonus.summer.description: Long days and a warm evening by the water — only opens in summer.
entries.map.bonus.autumn.title: Autumn glade
entries.map.bonus.autumn.description: Golden leaves and a chill before first snow — only opens in autumn.
entries.map.bonus.overlook.title: Valley overlook
entries.map.bonus.overlook.description: A cliff edge overlooking your whole road — a premium glade for those who climbed far.
entries.map.bonus.cliff.title: Cliff ledge
entries.map.bonus.cliff.description: A narrow shelf above the drop — a premium glade that demands precision.
entries.map.bonus.lagoon.title: Quiet lagoon
entries.map.bonus.lagoon.description: Night light over the water — a premium glade for lovers of silence and depth.
entries.map.bonus.marshal.title: Marshal's glade
entries.map.bonus.marshal.description: A trial for veterans: a tight site, strict signs, not one spare cell.
entries.map.bonus.summit.title: The summit
entries.map.bonus.summit.description: The road's final trial: winter, mist and a place you must earn.
entries.journey.main.story.45: The farm cart runs between yards again — seats for passengers who were not here yesterday.
entries.journey.main.story.50: The last field before the mills is ploughed. Someone hung a map of your network on a post — it is known farther north already.
entries.journey.main.story.55: The mill turns for the first time in a decade. Flour sacks bear marks of places you arranged.
entries.journey.main.story.58: The mill pond is full again — water wisely released now carries two boats.
entries.journey.main.story.60: The village streets are swept: half the houses will live, the others will stand as a museum of the road.
entries.journey.main.story.65: Village letters reached the station — people write to addresses that stood empty last year.
entries.journey.main.story.66: The village bell rings for the first time in five years. Travelers stop and listen.
entries.journey.main.story.70: The pass opens: your camps below became the spine of the road climbing up.
entries.journey.main.story.74: The mountain shelter is full — the first guests' journal has entries in hands you saw at your very first camp.
entries.journey.main.story.75: The resort gate creaks but opens. Behind it — a summer someone never got to finish.
entries.journey.main.story.80: The pool is cleaned and filling again. They say the water here healed not bodies — loneliness.
entries.journey.main.story.82: The resort's last glade is done. On the desk, a bell — silent for ten years — rings for you at last.
entries.journey.main.story.85: The shore road runs through salt and mist. Your fires are visible from the water — fishers already call them a lighthouse.
entries.journey.main.story.90: The coast's last pier takes a boat. Travelers step ashore straight into your camp.
entries.journey.main.story.95: Highland snow is clean as the first day. Trails you arranged already carry fresh tracks.
entries.journey.main.story.98: The shelter above the clouds is ready. Yesterday's storm passed — the place already gave someone cover.
entries.journey.main.story.100: The frontier post stands empty, but its wall map is current: someone is charting your places.
entries.journey.main.story.105: The road narrows to a trail. Ahead lie places maps mark only with the word farther.
entries.journey.main.story.106: The last stone post of the frontier. Beyond lies land where nobody lives yet — except those still on their way.
entries.journey.main.story.110: The haven. Your road ends here — and a place begins where all the world's roads come to rest.
entries.map.veiled: The world beyond is still veiled
